Dear All, 

I am a newbie user of Subjunc and featureCounts. I need to pass our data soon to my PI and I am seeing something that is a bit concenring: all my libraries get mapped more than 90% in subjunc but they don't get assigned more than 20% in featureCounts. I have tried -s 0 -s 1 -s 2. So I would not think it's strand thing. Also I have used the normal gtf file and dna primary assembly.fa file. 

These are the files I used for building the index, aligning, and counting: 

Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.dna.primary_assembly.fa

Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.86.gtf

I have attached the summary of featureCounts. 

Thank you very much your help and ideas are very appreciated, 

Aref
